description: Step 3b acceptance expectations (docs/step3b_contract.md, 验收), checked against the ClinicalTrials.gov records on 2026-11-03. For a future scripts/acceptance_step3b.py; the viewer will only display its result. match: NCT id of the trial action; expect.status per the contract; expect.unknown: regexes for requirements whose result must be unknown; expect.pass: regexes for requirements that must pass.

what.zh: SLC35A2 ex8（2 个月，"Hemoglobin 5"）/ AVTX-801 → 有条件：按 g/dL 符合排除标准（不能入组）；按 mmol/L 为未知（换算系数未核实）
what.en: SLC35A2 ex8 (2 months, "Hemoglobin 5") / AVTX-801 → conditional: excluded if g/dL; unknown if mmol/L (conversion factor not verified)

items.differs_from_official: The official Phase 0 answer reads 'Hemoglobin 5' as g/dL and excludes the patient. Hemoglobin is also reported in mmol/L (e.g. the Netherlands), where 5 mmol/L is about 8.1 g/dL and equally plausible; with two plausible units the rule (contract decision 3) gives conditional and the report states both outcomes. Decided 2026-11-03.
items.changed_2026_11_04: The mmol/L scenario was 'does_not_satisfy' (about 8.1 g/dL, using 0.6206 mmol/L per g/dL). No authoritative source for the hemoglobin mmol/L factor has been verified (AMA Manual of Style SI table lists only g/L; secondary sources give 0.6206 (monomer) or 0.155 (tetramer)), and the code never uses an unverified factor, so the mmol/L outcome is unknown with the reason 'conversion factor not verified'. To do: verify the factor from an authoritative source, then re-derive this expectation from the registry threshold.
